scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client,warehouse -c blue,green,yellow "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client" "npm run dev -w warehouse"
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w server && npm run build -w warehouse
scripts.start:prod: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w warehouse && npm run build -w server && npm start -w server
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w client && npm run lint -w server && npm run lint -w warehouse
scripts.lint:fix: npm run lint:fix -w client && npm run lint:fix -w server && npm run lint:fix -w warehouse
scripts.format: npm run format -w client && npm run format -w server && npm run format -w warehouse
scripts.format:check: npm run format:check -w client && npm run format:check -w server && npm run format:check -w warehouse
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w warehouse
